Chat request with max_tokens=1 terminates with length finish_reason

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ maxTokens: 1, messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Write a story" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4" });
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
}

void main();
```
